% Pattern: env/package. A structured proof of the package cheatpf2: each step
% is a step+ environment with its label as the argument, and the proof of the
% step is a prooof environment. Seen in the gold pilot (set E).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=lemma-1
% want step--1 other/case -
% want prooof-1 proof - proves=step--1
% want step--2 other/case -
% want prooof-2 proof - proves=step--2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{cheatpf2}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\begin{lemma}
Every compact space is bounded.
\end{lemma}
\begin{proof}
  \begin{step+}{step:cover}
    The space has a finite cover by balls.
  \end{step+}
  \begin{prooof}
    By compactness.
  \end{prooof}
  \begin{step+}{step:bound}
    A finite union of balls is bounded.
  \end{step+}
  \begin{prooof}
    Take the largest radius.
  \end{prooof}
\end{proof}
\end{document}
